NONE: › a type of oil from the argan tree, originally from Morocco, that is used to treat dry skin and hair or that can be used in cooking
› belonging to or relating to Argentina or its people
› a chemical element that is a gas found in air. Argon does not react with other elements and is sometimes used to make electric lights.
› words and expressions that are used by small groups of people and that are not easily understood by other people

example: thieves' argot
小偷的黑話

NONE: › If something is arguable, there could be some disagreement about it.
有疑問的；有商榷餘地的；可爭辯的

example: It is arguable which way is quicker.
走哪條路更快，還沒有定論。
It is arguable that the government has failed in this respect.
有理由說政府在這個方面失職了。

NONE: › used when stating an opinion or belief that you think can be shown to be true

example: He is arguably the world's best football player.
他可能是世界上最好的足球運動員。
Arguably, the drug should not have been made available.
或許這種藥根本就不該上市。

I: B1 [ I ] to speak angrily to someone, telling that person that you disagree with them

I or T: B2 [ I or T ] to give the reasons for your opinion, idea, belief, etc.

T: › [ T ] to show that something is true or exists

example: The children are always arguing.
孩子老是吵個不停。
Kids, will you stop arguing with each other?
孩子們，你們別再吵嘴了好不好？
They were arguing over/about which film to go and see.
他們正在爭論去看哪部電影。
The senator argued for/in favour of/against making cuts in military spending.
部長提出支持／反對削減軍費開支的理由。
[ + that ] The senator argued that cuts in military spending were needed.
部長論證了削減軍費開支的必要性。
You can argue the case either way.
這件事正說反說都有道理。
See also
well argued
The evidence argues a change in policy.
證據顯示政策有了變動。

NONE: › to disagree with a decision or statement

example: It doesn't matter what you say, he'll always argue the toss!
不管你說甚麼他都會唱反調！

C or U: B1 a disagreement, or the process of disagreeing
B2 a reason or reasons why you support or oppose an idea or suggestion, or the process of explaining these reasons
理由，論據，論點；論證，說理

example: The children had an argument about/over what game to play.
那群孩子為了玩哪個遊戲吵了起來。
He got into an argument with Jeff in the pub last night.
昨晚他和傑夫在酒館裡起了爭執。
A decision was finally made after some heated argument.
經過激烈的爭辯，最終作出了一項決定。
Now that we've heard all the arguments for and against the proposal, let's vote on it.
既然支持和反對這項提議的所有理由我們都已經聽過了，現在投票表決吧。
[ + that ] Her husband was not convinced by her argument that they needed a bigger house.
她提出理由說他們需要一個比較大的房子，但是她的丈夫沒有被說服。
I don't think that's a very strong/convincing/powerful argument.
我認為這個論點不太站得住腳／令人信服／有說服力。
The central argument (= main point) of the book is that some of the plays were not written by Shakespeare.
這本書的中心論點是，有幾個劇本並非出自莎士比亞之手。

NONE: › a set of arguments used to explain something or to persuade people

example: He produced very clever argumentation in support of the proposal.
他做出了非常清楚的論證支持這項提議。

NONE: › often arguing or wanting to argue

example: Don't be so argumentative.
別那麼好爭辯。

NONE: › loud argument or disagreement that is not usually serious

example: Did you hear all that argy-bargy last night?
你昨晚聽到他們拌嘴了嗎？

NONE: › a pattern used on items of clothing such as socks or sweaters, consisting of diamond shapes of various colours
（短襪、毛衣等）有多色菱形花紋的

example: This argyle V-neck sweater is a classic piece of golf clothing.
這件V領菱形花紋套頭毛衣是一件經典的高爾夫球著裝。
